name: Cleaning Task List
description: Supervisor monitors tasks by status/overdue and cancels tasks; staff see their own cleaning tasks.

name: Create Cleaning Task
description: Creates a cleaning task for a room with cleaning type, priority and due time.

name: Cleaning Task Detail
description: Displays a cleaning task; staff start it, update progress, report blockers and complete it.

name: Cleaning Assignment
description: Assigns or reassigns a cleaning task based on area and current workload.

name: Rework Task List
description: Lists rework tasks; staff see their own rework tasks.

name: Rework Task Detail
description: Displays defects to fix; staff accept, start and submit the rework with remediation notes.

name: Room Turnover History
description: Displays cleaning cycles of a room with assignees, times, inspection results and rework count.
